todos.text: Presale page: send the client and Angie the questions (dates, packages and caps, booking links, email platform, ad pixels, domain/DNS, Figma link and timing)
Get the Figma link with the updated images, pricing, booking links and terms from the client before the presale build starts

Presale placeholders for the client and Angie to confirm: opening date and time (the countdown is set to 2027-01-15 09:00 PT in data-countdown), founding tier names and presale prices (now "$TBC"; regular prices $399 / $339 / $275), the Buy now links to the booking platform (now "#"), the number of spots per tier, and presale terms.

Designer: open component S | Page Hero, select its Body L subtitle text and bind it to the Subtitle prop. The API can't bind text to a prop; until it's bound, /presale shows "A Lagree Fitness and Wellness Studio" instead of the presale subtitle. Other pages keep the default.
